defects.title: System discovery still exposes and normalizes raw `nostr.relays` outside the approved sidecar-first contract
evidence: internal/api/handlers/system.go:154-158 exposes `nostr.relays` when sidecar mode is disabled.
web/src/lib/stores/controlplane.svelte.js:184-191 still falls back to `nostr.relays` when `browser_relays` and `sidecar_url` are absent.
HITL-SYSTEM_DISCOVERY_RELAY_BOOTSTRAP-001 classified direct `nostr.relays` exposure as FIX/REMOVE rather than intended behavior.
defects.suspected_root_cause: Legacy sidecar-disabled compatibility behavior remains in both the system-info handler and the browser relay-resolution helper even though the approved slice is sidecar-first only.
defects.recommended_fix: Remove or quarantine raw `nostr.relays` exposure and normalization for browser bootstrap, then add contract coverage proving the approved sidecar-first path is the only accepted success path.

defects.title: Sidecar-first public bootstrap contract is only partially covered in handler tests
evidence: internal/api/handlers/system_test.go proves browser relay, sidecar URL, and feature flags, but does not assert the service-key-backed public bootstrap success case required by the approved contract.
test_matrix.json marks SDRB-T-001 as `modify_existing` and not implemented.
defects.suspected_root_cause: The original handler test suite predates the PSTF-approved sidecar-first AC set and stops short of the full approved bootstrap contract.
defects.recommended_fix: Extend the sidecar-capability handler test with a deterministic service-key-backed configuration and explicit assertions for the full approved bootstrap surface.

defects.title: Fail-closed browser bootstrap negatives for missing capability and missing browser bootstrap URLs are untested
evidence: web/tests/unit/controlplane-store.test.js currently proves only the relay-connection failure branch.
The AC requires deterministic failure for `relay_read_models=false` and for no advertised browser bootstrap URLs, but those branches are not exercised.
defects.suspected_root_cause: Bootstrap failure coverage was added incrementally and never expanded to the full fail-closed discovery contract.
defects.recommended_fix: Add unit cases for missing `relay_read_models` and missing `browser_relays`/`sidecar_url` to `web/tests/unit/controlplane-store.test.js`.

defects.title: Operator discovery fallback lacks a required negative test for empty browser bootstrap advertisement
evidence: cmd/cli/operator_nostr_test.go proves precedence for flag, environment, and discovery dedupe, but does not cover the no-browser-bootstrap-URLs failure branch.
The approved AC requires deterministic failure when discovery returns no `browser_relays` or `sidecar_url`.
defects.suspected_root_cause: The CLI precedence suite focused on positive precedence behavior and omitted the discovery-empty negative branch.
defects.recommended_fix: Add a fake system-info client case that returns no browser bootstrap URLs and assert the deterministic discovery error.

defects.title: Encrypted capability gating and multi-consumer discovery coherence are not fully proven against the approved contract
evidence: web/tests/unit/encrypted-controlplane.test.js proves that public browser relays are not treated as encrypted request targets, but it does not assert the approved minimal capability-gating framing end to end.
No current integration test proves one canonical `/api/v1/system/info` payload satisfies browser bootstrap, encrypted capability gating, and operator CLI discovery together.
pstf/cross_feature_analysis.md identified this cross-consumer system-info contract as a portfolio-level gap.
defects.suspected_root_cause: Consumer-specific tests were added independently, leaving the shared discovery contract under-proven across consumers.
defects.recommended_fix: Narrow the encrypted helper assertions to the approved capability-gating contract and add one shared fixture-driven system-info multi-consumer contract test.
